info.title: DharmaPragya Sacred Scriptures API
info.description: API for querying, retrieving, and synthesizing verified Sanatan Dharma scriptures (Bhagavad Gita, Upanishads, Vedas, Mahabharata, Ramayana, Patanjali Yoga Sutras).

get.description: Fetch scripture categories, chapter lists, or detailed verses with Sanskrit Devanagari text, transliteration, English/Hindi translations, word meanings, and commentaries.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Name of the scripture (e.g. 'Bhagavad Gita', 'Isha Upanishad', 'Rigveda')

parameters.name: chapter
parameters.description: Chapter or section number (e.g. 2 for Chapter 2)

post.description: Submit a philosophical or life inquiry to receive synthesized insights grounded in verified scripture citations.

200.description: Synthesized AI response with direct citations and verse cards
